choclair.bio: Scarborough-born rapper Choclair is a foundational Canadian hip-hop artist whose Juno-winning career helped bring Toronto rap into the national mainstream in the late 1990s and early 2000s.

courage my love.bio: Kitchener rock band Courage My Love built a Canadian pop-punk and alternative-rock following around the twin-sister core of Mercedes and Phoenix Arn-Horn before the project ended in 2020.

coleman hell.bio: Thunder Bay-born singer, songwriter and producer Coleman Hell blends electronic pop, folk and hip-hop influences and broke internationally with the 2015 single 2 Heads.

cri.bio: Québec producer CRi, born Christophe Dubé, makes dreamy electronic music that moves between house, dance-pop and atmospheric club production.

danko jones.bio: Toronto hard-rock trio Danko Jones has built a long-running Canadian and international career around high-energy live shows, heavy riffs and a punk-informed rock sound.

daniel powter.bio: Vernon, British Columbia-born singer-songwriter and pianist Daniel Powter is a Canadian pop artist best known internationally for the 2005 hit Bad Day.

dijahsb.bio: Toronto rapper DijahSB makes candid, melodic hip-hop centered on everyday life, mental health, identity and perseverance, pairing conversational lyricism with warm, jazz- and soul-leaning production.

dillanponders.bio: Toronto rapper DillanPonders is a prolific Canadian hip-hop artist whose catalogue moves between trap, introspective rap and hazy, atmospheric production.

dominique fils-aimé.bio: Montréal singer and composer Dominique Fils-Aimé blends jazz, blues, soul, R&B and reggae in award-winning work that explores Black musical history and contemporary identity.

donovan woods.bio: Sarnia-born Canadian singer-songwriter Donovan Woods combines folk and country storytelling with understated pop songwriting and a parallel career writing songs for other artists.

ekkstacy.bio: Vancouver singer-songwriter EKKSTACY makes moody Canadian indie rock and post-punk that mixes new-wave textures, punk energy and emotionally direct songwriting.

elise estrada.bio: Filipino-Canadian singer Elise Estrada built her pop and R&B career in Vancouver, releasing radio singles and a self-titled debut after moving to Canada from the Philippines.

enima.bio: Algerian-born, Montréal-raised rapper Enima is a prominent figure in Québec hip-hop whose music connects Montréal street rap with francophone influences from Canada and France.

eva avila.bio: Gatineau-born singer Eva Avila is a Canadian pop and R&B artist who rose to national prominence after winning the fourth season of Canadian Idol in 2006.

eva shaw.bio: Toronto-born Canadian DJ, producer and songwriter Eva Shaw makes electronic and hip-hop-influenced club music and has released work across both dance and rap scenes.

evil ebenezer.bio: Vancouver-based rapper and singer Evil Ebenezer is a veteran Canadian independent hip-hop artist known for extensive touring, darkly personal writing and a prolific catalogue.

faber drive.bio: Mission, British Columbia band Faber Drive is a Canadian pop-punk and pop-rock group known for radio hits including Tongue Tied, Second Chance and When I'm With You.

flore laurentienne.bio: Québec composer Mathieu David Gagnon's project Flore Laurentienne creates instrumental orchestral and electronic music inspired by nature, landscape and the St. Lawrence region.

fouki.bio: Montréal rapper FouKi, born Léo Fougères, is a leading voice in contemporary Québec hip-hop, mixing playful wordplay, melodic rap and wide-ranging influences from reggae to trap.
